cues.en: One of the biggest challenges in explaining and understanding how deep learning models work is that
cues.zh: 解釋與理解深度學習模型運作的一大挑戰，是

cues.en: the high dimensionality prevents us from being able to easily visualize the internal calculations and
cues.zh: 高維度讓我們難以輕易將內部計算與

cues.en: representations, and that is one of the reasons why simple regression models with only a handful of
cues.zh: 表徵視覺化。這也是為什麼只有少量

cues.en: parameters are much easier to understand and to explain, and so projecting these thousand dimensional
cues.zh: 參數的簡單迴歸模型，更容易理解與解釋。所以將這些上千維

cues.en: vectors down to 2 or 3 dimensions can be pretty useful for visualization and intuition.
cues.zh: 向量投影到二或三維，對視覺化與建立直覺很有用。

cues.en: On the other hand, as I explained, we are also ignoring a ton of information, and even though all
cues.zh: 另一方面，就像解釋過的，也忽略了大量資訊，即使

cues.en: of those other dimensions explain individually very little total variability, they might still contain a lot of important and relevant information.
cues.zh: 其他維度各自只解釋很少的總變異，它們仍可能包含許多重要、相關的資訊。

cues.en: So there is also a big risk of overinterpreting dimension reduced dynamics.
cues.zh: 因此，過度解讀降維後動態的風險也很大。

cues.en: In particular, with regards to PCA, the components are defined by variance, which means that PCA assumes that variance equals relevance.
cues.zh: 尤其是 PCA，成分以變異數定義，表示 PCA 假設變異數等於相關重要性。

cues.en: Now that is not necessarily the case.
cues.zh: 但這不一定成立。

cues.en: It's not necessarily true that dimensions that contain a lot of variability are the most important for the model to process a given token.
cues.zh: 含有大量變異的維度，不一定是模型處理某個 token 時最重要的。

cues.en: So it could also be interesting to explore trajectories with other dimension reduction techniques,
cues.zh: 因此，也可以用其他降維技巧探索軌跡，

cues.en: although really any compression method will suffer from similar limitations as PCA does in terms of
cues.zh: 但其實，任何壓縮方法，都有類似 PCA 的限制，

cues.en: highlighting only a few dimensions out of a very large number.
cues.zh: 只凸顯大量維度中的少數維度。

cues.en: Nonetheless, these kinds of analyses are great.
cues.zh: 儘管如此，這類分析很好，

cues.en: They can be insightful starting points to continue with more in-depth investigations.
cues.zh: 可以是有啟發性的起點，接著再深入研究。
